brief.scope: Whole inspector including navigation and layout
brief.job: Understand which recorded checks contributed to a coding-agent policy decision, then inspect their evidence
brief.visualDirection: Plain near-white canvas, black nodes and readable type, muted red for a recorded failing gate's contribution
brief.interaction: Selecting a recorded gate traces its connection once and opens attached evidence. Background polling must not replay motion or shift unchanged content. Respect reduced motion.
brief.truthConstraints: Recorded gates only, never invented evaluator rationale. Actual execution remains distinct from policy. A PASS rule outcome can coexist with an insufficient-evidence gate. Keep local read-only behavior and all archived details accessible.
brief.nextStep: Implementation in progress with the owner-requested Focus sidebar. No more concept generation. Offline UI and type checks pass; current Chrome navigation stalls before rendering, so updated browser verification and independent finish review remain pending.
